description: This file provides utility functions for client-side localStorage operations with SSR guards and JSON handling, including read, write, and clear functions, along with a versioned key constant.

methods.name: export function isBrowser(): boolean { isBrowser
methods.description: Checks if the code is running in a browser environment with access to window and localStorage.

methods.name: export function readStorage<T = unknown>(key: string): T | null { readStorage
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON data from localStorage by key, returning null if not available or on error.

methods.name: export function writeStorage<T = unknown>(key: string, value: T): void { writeStorage
methods.description: Stringifies and saves data to localStorage under the specified key, silently ignoring errors.

methods.name: export function clearStorage(key: string): void { clearStorage
methods.description: Removes the item from localStorage for the given key, ignoring errors.
